citation.authors: Alexander K, Carswell SB, Woolworth R, Simpson A et al

cited_by.title: Coping with anxiety day to day

record.population: 30 African American caregivers of people with HIV/AIDS, US
record.design: Four-week single-group feasibility trial of a mindfulness app
record.finding: All 30 completed it, and 83.3% rated usability acceptable. Baseline anxiety and depression risk were high. Change in anxiety was not tested; the authors call for a randomised trial.
record.note: Feasibility only: it does not show that the app reduces anxiety.
